The app inventories your local network and alerts you when something changes. Everything stays on your phone.
🔔 Alerts: new device, ARP spoofing, Internet outage, port forwarding
📶 Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, trackers, router and printers
🟡 PCAPdroid-style traffic capture, with a firewall
Each permission serves one specific feature. You can decline: that feature will simply be unavailable.
Required by Android to list Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Your position is never stored or sent.
Alerts for new devices, ARP spoofing, Internet outages, low toner.
Scan nearby devices, exposed services and trackers (AirTag, SmartTag, Tile).
Local VPN (traffic capture) and usage-stats access (per-app data): requested only when you open those screens.
Run a first scan from the home screen. Tip: add the “Scan network” tile to Quick Settings and the widget to your home screen.
